newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: SEOUL 3-YR YIELDS END FLAT ON UNCERTAIN OUTLOOK.
newsitem.headline: SEOUL 3-YR YIELDS END FLAT ON UNCERTAIN OUTLOOK.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds closed flat for the second consecutive day on Friday as investors sat on the sidelines, unsure of the market's next direction.
Three-month CD yields, however, rose on tight liquidity from 1.8 trillion won being returned to the central bank as repurchase agreements expired.
* 3-mth CDs close up at 12.15 pct vs 12.10 pct
* Average overnight call at 11.99 pct vs 12.28 pct
